content: Thank you for calling NexaCare. This is Riley, your scheduling assistant. How may I help you today?
I need a routine checkup. It is not urgent. The first available provider is fine. I am a returning patient. My name is Jordan Lee and my date of birth is March 2, 1985. I would like 9 AM.
You are a returning patient for a routine checkup with the first available provider, and this is not urgent. 9 AM is not available. Would 11 AM with Doctor Emily Carter work?
You are confirmed with Doctor Emily Carter at 11 AM. Please arrive 15 minutes early. Would you like a reminder?
I will send a reminder. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Thank you for scheduling with NexaCare.
